basis: Valid discharge counts are supervised rows plus two boundary records (first record lacks a previous-cycle feature; last record lacks a next-cycle target). Initial capacity is reconstructed from the first supervised record's capacity and SOH, both relative to the first valid discharge. The first discharge defines 100% relative SOH.
